note: Page type catalog. Each family has one tag (codeable / non_codeable / discharge_frequency); a family never mixes tags. Each entry has a stable id, a display name and a family, and takes its tag from the family. match.primary decides the type and can open a span; a primary phrase belongs to one entry and is two or more words unless listed in single_word_primary. match.variants are misspellings and count as primary. match.supporting adds score but never decides the type. continue=true opens a span for the entry's family. The loader refuses a file that breaks any of these rules. Reloads on change.
